test_overview: Regression test of core MVP messaging on the Team Chat app (Flask, port 8000). Steps 1-2 passed: alice logged in successfully, landed in #general with correct navigation (#general channel, Direct Messages section, My Messages entry), and her message appeared in the timeline with sender name and timestamp. Step 3 FAILED FATALLY: bob logged in and landed in #general (Alice's message visible), but after a single send of 'Regression reply from Bob.', the message was rendered FOUR identical times in context_B's timeline (confirmed via 4 visible rows at distinct screen positions) and SIX identical times in context_A (real-time delivery did work, but delivered multiple duplicate renders). A human user would plainly see the reply duplicated multiple times after a single send, which fails the verification that Bob's message appears in context_B as expected. Because this verification failure is not marked non-fatal, the entire test plan fails and steps 4-5 (DM creation and exchange) were not performed. Final score: 14/40.

steps.description: test_login_and_land_on_general: Login screen displayed at /. Logged in as alice/password-alice; login succeeded (chat app primary view, 'Alice Nguyen' shown). No invalid-credentials error. Landed in #general; navigation provides #general channel, Direct Messages section ('+ New Message'), and My Messages entry. All verifications passed.

test_send_message_in_general: Sent 'Regression test message from Alice.' in #general. Message appears in the public channel timeline with sender identifier 'Alice Nguyen' and timestamp '12:35 PM'. All verifications passed.

test_second_user_sees_message_and_replies: FATAL FAILURE. Bob logged in and landed in #general with Alice's message visible (non-fatal checks passed). After a single send of 'Regression reply from Bob.', the message appeared 4 TIMES in context_B (4 identical visible rows, same text/timestamp) and real-time delivery to context_A rendered it 6 TIMES without refresh. Duplicated rendering after one send fails the verification; step failed fatally, test plan fails.
test_create_dm_via_search: NOT PERFORMED - evaluation stopped due to the FATAL failure in step 3 (message duplication breaking core messaging).
test_dm_message_exchange: NOT PERFORMED - evaluation stopped due to the FATAL failure in step 3 (message duplication breaking core messaging).
